direct_inputs_to_this_stage.role: canonical/panda trajectory (retargeting output, consumed as validation input)

input.note: Upstream JSON was absent in this isolated Devbox (cross-Devbox handoff not implemented). vision.json and panda_trajectory.json were regenerated in-process from the same tracked video via src.reflex_stages reconstruction + retargeting, recorded under upstream_bootstrap/ and clearly distinguished from this owned stage.

exact_command: MUJOCO_GL=egl PYTHONPATH=/home/user/codex_hackathon /tmp/opencode/venv/bin/python -m src.reflex_stages validation --input reflex_live/demo-91f-reflex/upstream_bootstrap/panda_trajectory.json --config config/demo_config.json --output reflex_live/demo-91f-reflex/validation/physics_validation.json --video-output reflex_live/demo-91f-reflex/validation/physics_rollout.mp4 --grasp-frame 30 --release-frame 70 --job-id demo-91f-reflex

command_path_mapping.reason: neither dataminer/ nor persona/ exists in this repo; used the tracked equivalents without altering code

limitations: Cross-Devbox handoff is not implemented (reflex/agents/manifest.json handoff.implemented=false); no upstream bundle was pre-staged in this isolated Devbox. vision.json and panda_trajectory.json were regenerated in-process from the same tracked video via src.reflex_stages reconstruction+retargeting and recorded under upstream_bootstrap/; they are NOT outputs of this owned stage.

Job request referenced dataminer/config/demo_config.json and persona.reflex_stages; neither path exists in this repo. The actual tracked equivalents were used (config/demo_config.json and src.reflex_stages). No code was changed and no result was fabricated.

Canonical trajectory is an RGB-derived seed (MediaPipe palm UV + homography + phase-height), NOT DexYCB GT pose and NOT metric human-motion reconstruction (per data/dexycb/README.md). MuJoCo physics execution uses the object_centric_minimum_jerk strategy: the human video supplies grasp/release timing and the simulator resolves a feasible robot execution anchored to known bottle/target poses.

Headless Devbox had no GL by default; libegl1/libgles2/libopengl0 were installed via apt and MUJOCO_GL=egl was set for MuJoCo offscreen rendering. No secrets used, no nested Devbox launched, no DexYCB downloaded.

This single-process Retargeting->Validation run is NOT a 4-Agent live end-to-end demo (per workflow_runloop.md current scope). The Physical-Validation stage output (this agent_report.json, physics_validation.json, physics_rollout.mp4) is the only owned result.

physics_rollout.mp4 is byte-identical to the deterministic rollout produced by the same scene/seed/trajectory elsewhere (MuJoCo is deterministic); physics_validation.json differs only by reflex_stages agent_stage metadata (timestamps/paths).
